text:
mari: quick check — PR #5821 is ready for security review. touches: VPC ingress rules + new vault path `secret/redwood/onprem/shared_token`. planning to merge Tue 09:00 UTC if no blockers. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5821
jorge: taking a look now. main concern: the new path is writable by the deployer SA?
priya: heads up — this also changes the envoy sidecar config for onprem; need to confirm we won't expose metadata endpoints.
sam: @mari can you paste the terraform snippet for the vault policy you added? easier to eyeball perms.
mari: sure — snippet below:
```hcl
resource "vault_policy" "onprem_shared" {
  name   = "onprem-shared-token"
  policy = <<POL
path "secret/data/redwood/onprem/*" {
  capabilities = ["read", "list"]
}
path "secret/data/redwood/onprem/shared_token" {
  capabilities = ["create", "read", "update"]
}
POL
}
```
priya: thanks. my quick read: that `create` on shared_token is the risky bit. who needs create? should be restricted to the onboarder job, not deployer.
jorge: agree. we should change to only `read` for deploy paths, and carve out a narrowly-scoped service account for writes.
mari: okay — I can restrict write to `sa:onprem-onboarder` and keep deployer read-only. updating now.
lee-oncall: tagging since merge touches egress/VPC rules — if merge hits during weekday morning we should coordinate a short smoke test and keep rollback ready. prefer Wed 14:00 UTC for lower traffic.
sam: also adding request for explicit IAM audit entry. please add a short summary in the PR description of who gets write access + justification. auditors will ask.
mari: will add that. also adding test steps and smoke runbook in the PR body.
security-bot: automated check: vault policy lint passed. tfsec shows 1 warning (hardcoded CIDR in envoy config).
priya: can you paste the envoy snippet? we should prefer variable-driven cidr and document rationale if static required.
mari: envoy snippet: `0.0.0.0/0` in a legacy rule — doesn't need to stay. updating to `var.onprem_allowed_cidr_list`.
jorge: once perms and envoy CIDR are updated I'm happy to +1. also pinging infra to validate env during canary.
sam: PR checklist for merge: 1) write perms scoped 2) envoy CIDR paramterized 3) PR description includes audit note 4) smoke test window scheduled with oncall.
mari: updated PR and set merge target to Wed 14:00 UTC per @lee-oncall. leaving a note for infra for canary: cc @infra-team.
lee-oncall: noted. I'll be available during the window and will run the smoke script.
priya: after merge, let's schedule a short post-merge verification at +15m and +2h. add monitoring runbook.
mari: done. any last objections? otherwise I'll merge Wed 14:00 UTC assuming final +1 from @jorge. :thumbsup:
jorge: +1 — please squash and include audit blurb in commit message.
mari: thanks all, will merge and follow the runbook. :rocket:
